```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(MASS)
library(broom)

nature_colors <- c("#0173B2", "#DE8F05", "#029E73", "#CC78BC",
                  "#CA9161", "#949494", "#ECE133", "#56B4E9")

theme_nature <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

theme_set(theme_nature())

dat <- read_csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  mutate(
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q4", "Q3", "Q2", "Q1")),
    leadership = case_when(
      vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
      jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
      TRUE ~ "Other-led"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Other-led", "JP-led", "VN-led")),
    age = 2025 - year,
    macro_area = case_when(
      HS == 1 ~ "HS",
      LS == 1 ~ "LS",
      PS == 1 ~ "PS",
      SS == 1 ~ "SS",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ) |> factor()
  )
```

## Model Assumption Checks
```{r fig-citation-distribution}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(dat, aes(x = cited)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#4A90E2", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Citations (log scale)", y = "Frequency")
```
```{r tbl-citation-summary-stats}
dat |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Median = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = round(sd(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Variance = round(var(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min = min(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Var/Mean ratio` = round(var(cited, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    `% zeros` = round(100 * mean(cited == 0), 2)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
```{r tbl-overdispersion-test}
model_poisson <- glm(cited ~ leadership + factor(year) + macro_area,
                     data = dat, family = poisson)
model_nb <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership + factor(year) + macro_area,
                   data = dat)

tibble(
  Model = c("Poisson", "Negative Binomial"),
  `Log-likelihood` = c(logLik(model_poisson)[1], logLik(model_nb)[1]),
  AIC = c(AIC(model_poisson), AIC(model_nb)),
  BIC = c(BIC(model_poisson), BIC(model_nb)),
  `Theta (dispersion)` = c(NA, model_nb$theta)
) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
```{r tbl-lr-test-overdispersion}
lr_stat <- 2 * (logLik(model_nb)[1] - logLik(model_poisson)[1])
lr_pval <- pchisq(lr_stat, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)

tibble(
  Test = "LR test: Poisson vs Negative Binomial",
  `LR statistic` = round(lr_stat, 2),
  `df` = 1,
  `p-value` = format.pval(lr_pval, digits = 3),
  Interpretation = ifelse(lr_pval < 0.001, "Significant overdispersion detected", "No overdispersion")
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Regression Models: Impact Parity Tests
```{r models}
model_data <- dat |>
  filter(!is.na(cited), !is.na(leadership), !is.na(quartile),
         !is.na(fund), !is.na(OA), !is.na(coop), !is.na(macro_area)) |>
  mutate(
    prop_vn_centered = scale(prop_vn_authors, scale = FALSE)[,1]
  )

m1 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership + factor(year) + macro_area,
             data = model_data)

m2 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership + coop + prop_vn_centered + 
               factor(year) + macro_area,
             data = model_data)

m3 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership + coop + prop_vn_centered +
               fund + bilateral_funding + OA + quartile +
               factor(year) + macro_area,
             data = model_data)

m4 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership * fund + leadership * quartile + 
               coop + prop_vn_centered + bilateral_funding + OA +
               factor(year) + macro_area,
             data = model_data)
```
```{r tbl-regression-models}
list(
  "Model 1" = m1,
  "Model 2" = m2,
  "Model 3" = m3,
  "Model 4" = m4
) |>
  map_dfr(~{
    tidy(., conf.int = TRUE) |>
      filter(str_detect(term, "leadership")) |>
      transmute(
        term = term,
        IRR = exp(estimate),
        CI_lower = exp(conf.low),
        CI_upper = exp(conf.high),
        p.value = p.value
      )
  }, .id = "Model") |>
  mutate(
    across(IRR:p.value, ~round(., 3)),
    Sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
```{r tbl-full-model3}
tidy(m3, conf.int = TRUE) |>
  filter(!str_detect(term, "year|macro_area")) |>
  transmute(
    Term = term,
    IRR = exp(estimate),
    CI_lower = exp(conf.low),
    CI_upper = exp(conf.high),
    `p-value` = p.value,
    Sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(across(IRR:`p-value`, ~round(., 3))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Interaction Effects
```{r fig-leadership-funding-interaction}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

model_data |>
  filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led")) |>
  bind_cols(pred = predict(m4, newdata = filter(model_data, 
                                                 leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led")),
                           type = "response")) |>
  group_by(leadership, fund) |>
  summarise(
    mean_pred = mean(pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(pred, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fund, y = mean_pred, color = leadership, group = leadership)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_pred - 1.96*se, 
                    ymax = mean_pred + 1.96*se),
                width = 0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("VN-led" = "#4A90E2", "JP-led" = "#E85D75")) +
  labs(x = "Funding status", y = "Predicted citations", color = NULL)
```
```{r fig-leadership-quartile-interaction}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

model_data |>

                                                 leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led"),
                                                 !is.na(quartile)),
                           type = "response")) |>
  group_by(leadership, quartile) |>

  scale_color_manual(values = c("VN-led" = "#4A90E2", "JP-led" = "#E85D75")) +
```


## Model Diagnostics
```{r tbl-model-fit}
tibble(
  Model = c("Model 1", "Model 2", "Model 3", "Model 4"),
  N = c(nobs(m1), nobs(m2), nobs(m3), nobs(m4)),
  `Log-Lik` = c(logLik(m1)[1], logLik(m2)[1], logLik(m3)[1], logLik(m4)[1]),
  AIC = c(AIC(m1), AIC(m2), AIC(m3), AIC(m4)),
  BIC = c(BIC(m1), BIC(m2), BIC(m3), BIC(m4)),
  `Theta` = c(m1$theta, m2$theta, m3$theta, m4$theta)
) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
```{r fig-residual-diagnostics}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

model_data |>
  bind_cols(
    fitted = predict(m3, type = "response"),
    residuals = residuals(m3, type = "pearson")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = log(fitted + 1), y = residuals)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "#4A90E2") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#E85D75", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Log predicted citations", y = "Pearson residuals")
```
```{r fig-qq-plot}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

residuals_pearson <- residuals(m3, type = "pearson")
qqnorm(residuals_pearson, main = "", pch = 20, col = alpha("#4A90E2", 0.3))
qqline(residuals_pearson, col = "#E85D75", lwd = 2)
```

## Statistical Tests for Parity
```{r tbl-wilcox-tests}
leadership_pairs <- list(
  "All papers" = dat |> filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led")),
  "Funded only" = dat |> filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led"), 
                                fund == "Funded"),
  "Q1 only" = dat |> filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led"), 
                            quartile == "Q1"),
  "Q1 + Funded" = dat |> filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led"),
                                quartile == "Q1", fund == "Funded")
)

map_dfr(leadership_pairs, ~{
  test <- wilcox.test(cited ~ leadership, data = .)
  vn_mean <- mean(.$cited[.$leadership == "VN-led"], na.rm = TRUE)
  jp_mean <- mean(.$cited[.$leadership == "JP-led"], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  tibble(
    `VN mean` = round(vn_mean, 1),
    `JP mean` = round(jp_mean, 1),
    `Ratio` = round(vn_mean / jp_mean, 2),
    `p-value` = format.pval(test$p.value, digits = 3)
  )
}, .id = "Subset") |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r fig-residuals-by-leadership}
model_data |>
  filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led")) |>
  bind_cols(residuals = residuals(m3, type = "pearson")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = leadership, y = residuals, fill = leadership)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#E85D75") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("VN-led" = "#4A90E2", "JP-led" = "#E85D75")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Pearson residuals") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


```{r fig-citations-prop-scatter}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  filter(!is.na(prop_vn_authors)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = prop_vn_authors, y = cited)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.1, color = "#4A90E2", size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "#E85D75", linewidth = 1.5, se = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Vietnamese author proportion", y = "Citations (log scale)")
```

```{r fig-parity-conditions-heatmap}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led"), !is.na(quartile)) |>
  group_by(leadership, fund, quartile) |>
  summarise(mean_cited = mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = leadership, values_from = mean_cited) |>
  mutate(ratio = `VN-led` / `JP-led`) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = quartile, y = fund, fill = ratio)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(ratio, 2)), color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#E85D75", mid = "white", high = "#4A90E2",
                       midpoint = 1, name = "Citation\nratio") +
  labs(x = "Journal quartile", y = "Funding status",
       caption = "Ratio = VN-led / JP-led citations")
```

# 3
```{r tbl-leadership-overall-fixed}
dat |>
  filter(!is.na(vn_led), !is.na(jp_led)) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `VN-led` = sum(vn_led == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `VN-led (%)` = round(100 * mean(vn_led == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    `JP-led` = sum(jp_led == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `JP-led (%)` = round(100 * mean(jp_led == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    `Other-led` = sum(vn_led == 0 & jp_led == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Other-led (%)` = round(100 * mean(vn_led == 0 & jp_led == 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r fig-residual-diagnostics-fixed}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

model_data_with_resid <- model_data |>
  mutate(
    fitted = predict(m3, type = "response"),
    residuals = residuals(m3, type = "pearson")
  )

ggplot(model_data_with_resid, aes(x = log(fitted + 1), y = residuals)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "#4A90E2") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#E85D75", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Log predicted citations", y = "Pearson residuals")
```

```{r fig-predicted-citations-matrix-fixed}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

pred_grid <- expand_grid(
  leadership = factor(c("VN-led", "JP-led"), levels = c("Other-led", "JP-led", "VN-led")),
  quartile = factor(c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), levels = c("Q4", "Q3", "Q2", "Q1")),
  fund = "Funded",
  coop = "multilateral",
  prop_vn_centered = 0,
  bilateral_funding = 0,
  OA = "OA",
  year = 2020,
  macro_area = "PS"
)

pred_grid |>
  mutate(pred = predict(m4, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = quartile, y = leadership, fill = pred)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(pred, 1)), color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#E8F4F8", high = "#0173B2", 
                     name = "Predicted\ncitations") +
  labs(x = "Journal quartile", y = "Leadership")
```
